mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHATBOT_BLOCK (block_type, block_value, reason, blocked_by, blocked_at, expires_at, is_active) VALUES (#{blockType}, #{blockValue}, #{reason}, #{blockedBy}, NOW(), #{expiresAt}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reason = VALUES(reason), blocked_by = VALUES(blocked_by), blocked_at = NOW(), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at)
mapper.select: SELECT block_id, block_type, block_value, reason, blocked_by, blocked_at, expires_at, is_active FROM CHATBOT_BLOCK WHERE block_id = #{blockId}

SELECT block_id, block_type, block_value, reason, blocked_by, blocked_at, expires_at, is_active FROM CHATBOT_BLOCK
WHERE is_active = 1
ORDER BY blocked_at DESC
